title: Do All Visual Tokens Matter Equally? Object-Evidence Preserving Token Merging for Vision-Language Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2607.04605v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-vector vision-language retrieval preserves fine-grained visual evidence through maximum-similarity late interaction, but dense image-side tokens make storage and scoring expensive. Existing token compression methods reduce this cost, yet they can remove or collapse object- and region-level evidence that future query tokens may need to select. We propose SaMer, an object-aware token merging framework that compresses image-side post-projector tokens into $K$ representative centroids while preserving the original late-interaction interface. SaMer uses object annotations only during training as a merge prior to discourage cross-instance mixing, requires no ground-truth bounding boxes or detectors at inference time, and adapts only the shared projection layer with frozen vision and language backbones. With $K=64$, SaMer removes more than 93% of image-side tokens and reduces ColPali storage by $16.09\times$, while improving R@1

translated_title: 所有视觉标记都同样重要吗？面向视觉-语言检索的对象证据保持标记合并
translated_abstract: 多向量视觉-语言检索通过最大相似度后期交互机制保留了细粒度的视觉证据，但图像侧密集的标记使得存储和评分成本高昂。现有的标记压缩方法虽然降低了这一成本，却可能移除或合并掉后续查询标记所需选择的对象级和区域级证据。我们提出了SaMer，一个对象感知的标记合并框架，它将图像侧投影后的标记压缩为K个代表性中心点，同时保留原始的后期交互接口。SaMer仅在训练阶段使用对象标注作为合并先验来避免跨实例混合，在推理时无需真实边界框或检测器，并且仅在冻结的视觉和语言骨干网络下微调共享投影层。当K=64时，SaMer移除了超过93%的图像侧标记，将ColPali存储减少了16.09倍，同时提升了R@1检索性能。
tldr: 提出对象感知的标记合并框架SaMer，将图像侧标记压缩为K个中心点并保留对象级证据，在移除93%以上图像标记、将存储减少16倍的同时提升了视觉-语言检索性能。
en_tdlr: SaMer is an object-aware token merging framework that compresses image-side tokens into K representative centroids while preserving object-level evidence, removing over 93% of tokens, reducing storage by 16x, and improving vision-language retrieval performance.
